newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in, sells dlrs at 870.00 won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in, sells dlrs at 870.00 won.

text.p: The central bank of Korea intervened in the interbank market at the opening on Thursday, selling dollars at around 870.00, dealers said.
But the bank denied the action, as it routinely does.
The Bank of Korea came in to slow the won's steep decline against the dollar, traders said.
Demand for the dollar has been rising because of growing import deals, they said.
Traders said the won was expected to drop further unless the central bank supports the currency, traders said.
At 0038 GMT, the won traded at 869.00.
